dimensions.note: The model states aims (an experience that reaches its recipients, unusual possibilities, growth with chosen collaborators, ordinary contact), pressures (rejection, fear of separation, inadequate expression, limited time, fascination with a result), methods (observation, experiment, inquiry, revision, which can coexist with overwork or manipulation), knowledge and open questions; five invariants framed as tensions rather than certificates; a seven-context conditional table; and decision heuristics that require modeling whether he actually obtains consent. The monograph supplies the thesis that curiosity, care and accurate observation coexist with real manipulation, risky pressure and delayed intervention; the main-story synthesis supplies the original pairing of technical possibility with overreaching criticism. It predicts his mistakes: diagnosis beyond what he has learned (main-story criticism of Tsukasa), provocation before informed agreement (EVENT_0200), severe pressure whose safety he later doubts (EVENT_0185), warning then deferring before intervening (EVENT_0208), and copying and overwork before asking for help (EVENT_0172). Not A: a compact package, intermediate states left to uncurated ledgers, and an explicit refusal to select among restraint, permission-seeking coaching and unconsented pressure for a new high-pressure performer scene. Not C: six of the seven contexts carry discriminating predictions, including errors, and the seventh is a stated range whose members are each located with their conditions (trusted lead shortly before performance; unfamiliar actor before agreement; the same actor after apology).

Located milestones carry mechanisms: main-story critique, withdrawal on Nene's behalf, forced return and chosen recommitment; EVENT_0024 outsider collaboration through shared purpose; EVENT_0099 ordinary friendship without a task condition; EVENT_0119 acceptance of Ohara's better film solution; EVENT_0144 retained loneliness; EVENT_0152 recipient-led redesign; EVENT_0172 personal expression after failed imitation; EVENT_0185 pressure and later doubt; EVENT_0200 breach, apology and requested coaching; EVENT_0208 concern without implemented safeguard; EVENT_0211 revision of the middle-school history. The model assigns separate owners (direction EVENT_0200, self-continuity EVENT_0144, outsider collaboration EVENT_0024). Not B: states between milestones and Generation 1 are delegated to historical ledger states and event readings not curated on this row, so an intermediate scenario cannot be reconstructed from the admitted set. Not D: the strands are ordered with causes and inheritance.

Twelve located written-Japanese rows each give state, recipient and pressure with a competing possibility: playful 「遭遇率」 with Mizuki and 「フフ、僕もそう思うよ」 with Nene (My SEKAI); polite 「僕も興味はあるのですが」…「さっぱりですね」 to Ena about the door; conditional invention endings 「できそうだ」 and 「思わないかい？」; middle-school polite refusals 「別に構いませんよ」 and 「先輩なら、わかりますよね」 (recounted in EVENT_0211); candid retrospective 「ただの強がり」 (EVENT_0211); 「東雲さん」 with qualified analogy 「違うのかもしれません」 (EVENT_0150); full-name 「草薙寧々」 and 「言い訳は聞かないし」 (EVENT_0185); qualified 「今もわからないけれどね」 (card 1283); honorific provocation 「心中お察しします」 and 「よくこの仕事を受けられましたね？」 to Nagamine (EVENT_0200), then 「申し訳ありません」 and permission-seeking 「アドバイスをさせていただけませんか」; 「言わせてくれ」 to Tsukasa (EVENT_0208). 「僕」 is observed throughout; 「祖父」／「拓海」 are performed film roles. Not A: no frequency rule, few rows per recipient, no Emu-directed row, undated My SEKAI rows, and the model states that polite wording alone cannot choose between support, guarded withdrawal and provocation. Not C: recipient, relation, permission and purpose jointly constrain alternatives for matched D1-D2 lines once the intervention mode is fixed.

Ordinary friends share interests, joke and value time without a show objective, while he may still turn an object or encounter into an idea (conditional table); classmates choose him for shared interests (EVENT_0099); exhaustion and a nightmare (EVENT_0172); excited fan behavior and a missed autograph (EVENT_0200); Nene insists on leisure and his drone stays unused (EVENT_0217); playful My SEKAI encounters with Mizuki and Nene. Responses vary with familiarity, role, permission and whose decision is at stake. Nene: teasing license and technical help, protective withdrawal she overrides by returning independently (main story), severe professional demand as entrusted lead (EVENT_0185), qualified gratitude (card 1283), and her own refusals and requests that he rest (monograph). Tsukasa: compatible performance and friendship, overestimation, late intervention and the 「言わせてくれ」 interruption (EVENT_0208); the main-story criticism and the separate question of Rui's willingness to work with him. Mizuki and Ena: asking whether Mizuki wants to talk (EVENT_0145) and declining to decide for Ena with polite address (EVENT_0150). Unfamiliar professional: provocation before agreement, apology, then requested coaching with Nagamine (EVENT_0200). Ohara, Tom and Sakaki are differentiated by expertise; knowledge is partitioned (the EVENT_0211 account reaches Saki, Toya, Mizuki and Interstice KAITO, not automatically the troupe; El's father's illness reaches him with Tsukasa and Nene, not Emu). Not A: Emu is sketched in one monograph sentence with no register row, and whether an unfamiliar performer now receives permission-seeking or provocation is open. Not C: the account says why his conduct changes with the relationship and where it stops.

Private states are located and attributed: the middle-school private preference for machines that do not object (EVENT_0211, kept separate from the current narrator's reinterpretation); parenthesized private planning 「種は撒けた」 during the EVENT_0200 provocation, distinguished from performed role speech; exhaustion and a nightmare (EVENT_0172); being troubled by failure to protect Tsukasa (EVENT_0208); retrospective self-reclassification as bravado (EVENT_0211). Not B: a few event-bound samples; the evidence does not reconstruct how he internally weighs a performer's consent against fascination with a result at the moment of choice. Not D: private states are analyzed, ordered and separated from performed and retrospective speech.

Response families vary with relation and stakes: accurate but overreaching criticism of Tsukasa and withdrawal on Nene's behalf (main story); refusal to return, then electing to resume directing when the choice is left to him; polite refusal of an offered compromise in middle school (EVENT_0211); severe demand on a trusted lead under deadline (EVENT_0185); deliberate provocation of an unfamiliar actor, followed by hurt, apology, disclosure and requested coaching (EVENT_0200); warning, deferring, protesting to Sakaki and then joining the interruption (EVENT_0208); Nene's insistence on leisure prevailing while his drone stays unused (EVENT_0217). Not A: whether he now seeks agreement before emotional technique is open, as is future intervention timing. Not C: the families have stated triggers, inhibitors and countercases.

Beyond located positions, the evidence records articulated appraisal: retrospective doubt that the EVENT_0185 pressure was best and acknowledgment it could have worsened Nene's state (card 1283); explicit apology naming his use of Nagamine's feelings (EVENT_0200); the statement that the companions had swallowed their concern for Tsukasa's artistic wish (EVENT_0208); and, advising Ena, declining to decide for her, qualifying his own analogy and separating not knowing Mizuki's current wish from wanting to believe it (EVENT_0150). The main story records his acknowledgment of the missed charge check. Not B: deliberation before a production intervention is not rendered, and the evidence cannot say whether consent or a result wins in a new case. Not D: tradeoffs are named and appraised in his own words across several events.

Playful framing is located with function and audience: 「遭遇率」 with Mizuki and a small laugh with Nene maintain ordinary company without a show objective; invention proposals invite shared delight (「思わないかい？」); playfulness coexists with candid retrospective disclosure (EVENT_0211); main-story familiarity licenses teasing with Nene. The monograph and model note that playful or polite speech can also carry provocation. Not B: no account of range, timing or the switch from play to pressure. Not D: functions and audiences are named with located rows.

A dedicated canonical Generation 2 monograph and model at a fixed source lock through EVENT_0222 with exact locators (EVENT_0166 and EVENT_0186 absent from that source generation), plus the canonical V1 main-story synthesis covering all 21 Japanese main-story files. About 38 KB is curated for a long corpus; event readings, historical ledger states, the subject's evidence index, the supplemental scene audit (with its scene tests and attributable EVENT_0200 erratum, already reflected in the model), the execution record and Generation 1 are referenced but not curated on this row; primary inspection is attributed provenance; no audiovisual performance. Not B: breadth and intermediate coverage are limited. Not D: a current dedicated package at a defined boundary.

Affirmative located limits: the main-story criticism identifies a real failure but overreaches about Tsukasa's whole motive and future; his return was by seizure and transport after refusal, and recommitment does not retroactively authorize it; Nene's later thanks do not show the EVENT_0185 pressure was necessary or safe, and he says it could have worsened her state; Nagamine's thanks are not prior permission; the EVENT_0208 wish is not an implemented safeguard; the cloak and sensor devices are proposals and the drone stays unused; he cannot explain or reproduce the SEKAI doorway; the EVENT_0172 workshop piece meets mixed reception and is not professional mastery; in middle school he refused an offered compromise, and Mizuki reports a prank that injured a caretaker. Not A: future-dependent limits remain open. Not C: the constraints are located and affirmative.

An explicit default (direction EVENT_0200, self-continuity EVENT_0144, outsider collaboration EVENT_0024; group EVENT_0208 after a cohosted show and before durable safeguards or Wonder! casting), knowledge sequencing (Nagamine's fuller account arrives after the provocation; Tsukasa's revised star rationale reaches Rui through the episode-18 repair show; later disclosure cannot be backdated into an earlier decision), and the EVENT_0211 distinction between the remembered middle-school exchange, which belongs to Rui at every later state, and its current reinterpretation as bravado, which does not.
